publication_boundary: Rows under an import_run whose state is discovering/validating are unpublished technical staging. They acquire immutable SourceObservation/Finding authority only when the complete run atomically transitions to staged, waiting_review or recovery_required after EOF/count/fingerprint verification. Replay/noop cleanup occurs before that transition.

tables.name: source_observations
columns: source_observation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY
import_run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES import_runs(import_run_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
source_family TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(source_family IN ('rfc_enhanced','wfm_service_provider'))
entity_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(entity_kind IN ('rfc','wfm','invalid_row'))
identity_state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(identity_state IN ('valid','invalid'))
canonical_primary_id TEXT
canonical_parent_rfc_no TEXT
row_ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(row_ordinal>=1)
sheet_ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(sheet_ordinal>=1)
row_logical_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(row_logical_sha256)=64)
source_row_chronology_utc INTEGER CHECK(source_row_chronology_utc IS NULL OR source_row_chronology_utc>=0)
presence_state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(presence_state IN ('observed_valid_identity','observed_invalid_identity'))
recorded_at_utc INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(recorded_at_utc>=0)

CHECK((identity_state='valid' AND entity_kind IN ('rfc','wfm') AND canonical_primary_id IS NOT NULL AND presence_state='observed_valid_identity') OR (identity_state='invalid' AND entity_kind='invalid_row' AND canonical_primary_id IS NULL AND canonical_parent_rfc_no IS NULL AND presence_state='observed_invalid_identity'))
CHECK((source_family='rfc_enhanced' AND (entity_kind='rfc' OR entity_kind='invalid_row')) OR (source_family='wfm_service_provider' AND (entity_kind='wfm' OR entity_kind='invalid_row')))
CHECK((entity_kind='wfm' AND canonical_parent_rfc_no IS NOT NULL) OR entity_kind<>'wfm')
rules: once parent run is published, rows are immutable normalized source evidence independent from whether any proposal is accepted
valid source presence is authoritative only for published staged/review/recovery runs and remains recorded when later proposal is rejected/deferred/unresolved
RFC canonical_primary_id is exact NC+14; WFM canonical_primary_id is exact TK+14 and canonical_parent_rfc_no is exact NC+14
recognized RFC branch artifact rows use invalid_row evidence/finding classification and never canonicalize into the base RFC
physical row order is provenance only; logical fingerprint serialization sorts by canonical identities/field keys after duplicate/conflict classification

tables.name: source_observation_fields
columns: source_observation_field_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY
source_observation_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES source_observations(source_observation_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
field_key TEXT NOT NULL
field_class TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(field_class IN ('active','deferred'))
value_state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(value_state IN ('usable','blank','unknown','malformed'))
value_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(value_kind IN ('text','controlled','instant','duration_seconds'))
source_text TEXT
normalized_text TEXT
integer_value INTEGER
vocabulary_id TEXT
field_logical_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(field_logical_sha256)=64)

CHECK((value_state='usable' AND value_kind IN ('text','controlled') AND source_text IS NOT NULL AND normalized_text IS NOT NULL AND integer_value IS NULL) OR (value_state='usable' AND value_kind IN ('instant','duration_seconds') AND source_text IS NOT NULL AND normalized_text IS NULL AND integer_value IS NOT NULL) OR (value_state<>'usable' AND normalized_text IS NULL AND integer_value IS NULL))
CHECK((value_kind='controlled' AND vocabulary_id IS NOT NULL) OR (value_kind<>'controlled' AND vocabulary_id IS NULL))
rules: only registered allowlisted active/deferred fields are persisted
unallowlisted/discarded columns are never copied into observation fields
source_text is bounded allowlisted review evidence only; it is never executed/interpreted as code
normalized_text/integer_value exist only for usable validated values; malformed/unknown/blank rows cannot smuggle authoritative normalized meaning
deferred fields are retained with provenance but generate no Beta 1.0 domain mutation unless separately activated by authority
one source observation has at most one field row per canonical field_key

tables.name: import_findings
columns: import_finding_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY
import_run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES import_runs(import_run_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
source_observation_id TEXT REFERENCES source_observations(source_observation_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
field_key TEXT
finding_code TEXT NOT NULL
severity TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(severity IN ('info','warning','error','high_risk'))
scope_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(scope_kind IN ('workbook','sheet','row','field','identity','chronology','replay','proposal'))
message_text TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(message_text)>0)
recorded_at_utc INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(recorded_at_utc>=0)
rules: finding_code is from a closed LLD-04 catalogue; message_text is bounded deterministic operator explanation, never raw exception/environment serialization
published findings never become domain authority but remain immutable review evidence
invalid identity rows can have findings without creating target entities
source absence for RFC/WFM never produces per-record disappearance findings

indexes: CREATE INDEX idx_source_observation_parent ON source_observations(canonical_parent_rfc_no,import_run_id,source_observation_id) WHERE canonical_parent_rfc_no IS NOT NULL
CREATE INDEX idx_finding_observation_fk ON import_findings(source_observation_id,import_finding_id) WHERE source_observation_id IS NOT NULL
protection: BEFORE UPDATE on source_observations/source_observation_fields/import_findings always raises append-only protection

BEFORE DELETE on these rows permits only the dedicated unpublished-staging cleanup path while the owning import_run is still validating; all rows belonging to a staged/waiting_review/recovery_required/partially_accepted/accepted/rejected run are undeletable

replay/newer-identical cleanup deletes findings then fields then observations while run is validating, then transitions the empty-evidence run to noop/noop_pending_checkpoint so no duplicate SourceObservation history survives
failed/interrupted unpublished staging may be technically cleaned under the same guard; this is not operational-history purge because the run was never published as exact-source evidence
field-key/value-kind/source-family registry consistency is verified at persistence boundary and migration verifier has golden invalid-write tests
